targetDomain: Pinned syntax-family catalogue of consumed direct string comparisons, switch labels, literal keyword dispatch handler names and existing lens/list-action constants; no complete Canvas interface schema is inferred.
forwardMap: Observe the exact current canvas renderer AST and compare every observed family/label with the committed catalogue. Public runtime lens/list-action vocabulary is projected from the constants actually used by current consumers.
partiality: Closed only for the explicitly observed syntax families. Computed/indirect labels, extension vocabularies, slot cardinality and full authored type closure remain unproved.
failure: The characterization test refuses additions/removals/reclassification or stale source SHA; runtime lens normalization retains its existing explicit options fallback.
authorityEffect: Bounded current runtime qualification only. Explicit host operations remain with the caller/server; no generic executable algebra, scientific acceptance or production execution grant follows.
stateOwner: Caller owns input program/capabilities; current client memory/controller own their local state. Returned snapshots have detached persistent values; explicit runtime evidence references remain shared where documented.
evidence: Hand-authored normative JSON cases plus semantic-translation-inspector-canvas.test.mjs in source, assembled SDK and both isolated bootstraps, with a pinned AST vocabulary catalogue.
default: Current public compatibility defaults remain explicit: omitted network uses authored net configuration, unknown lens mode selects options, absent transfer format uses REL, and omitted optional UI fields are sanitized. Retained no-default extraction intent is not asserted restored.

records.selection: Complete retained obligations selected; sparse reconstitution intent, if present, remains recorded as a separate variant.

sourceDomain: Explicit injected appender, publisher, telemetry event host, renderer controller and motion/placement commit callbacks at current browser boundaries.
targetDomain: Current explicit callback boundaries in persistence, renderer telemetry and interaction controllers; no generic host-effect executor or full canvas extraction is restored.
forwardMap: Invoke the named current public operations and the actual shared browser call sites. Current explicit callback boundaries in persistence, renderer telemetry and interaction controllers; no generic host-effect executor or full canvas extraction is restored.
preservedInformation: Observed command/revision, stage/detail, controller callback identity and ordered outcome/refusal at the selected seams.
lostInformation: Host scheduling, complete request protocol, generic effect receipts, rasterization and unobserved capabilities are not reconstructed.
identity: Caller capability instance, current command/page or interaction context; no generic effectRequest identity is synthesized.
partiality: Only these named host seams are qualified. EventSource, storage, scheduler, rasterization and arbitrary effect requests remain outside this contract translation.
failure: Host semantic effect failures propagate; observation failures are contained. No local host result grants production or scientific acceptance.
authorityEffect: Bounded current runtime qualification only. Explicit host invocations remain with their caller/server; no generic algebra, execution grant or scientific authority follows.
stateOwner: Caller owns injected capability; registry/controller own their local state; server owns save admission.
evidence: Hand-authored normative cases and semantic-translation-browser-host.test.mjs executed in source, assembled SDK and both isolated bootstraps; these are bounded witnesses, not universal semantic equivalence.
falsifier: An observer failure retries an accepted save, an unregistered inherited renderer resolves, or a throwing commit leaves an active interaction.
default: Current public API compatibility defaults are retained where supplied by the implementation; retained no-default extraction intent is not claimed restored.

records.selection: Complete retained obligations selected; sparse reconstitution intent, if present, remains recorded as a separate variant.

authorityEffect: Bounded current runtime qualification only. Pure projections do not grant authority; explicit filesystem/import effects remain with their caller and loader. No generic executable algebra, scientific acceptance or production admission follows.

sourceDomain: Current canvas viewState/runtime.workbenchUi and explicit session or named-draft snapshot records.
targetDomain: Detached persistent view state and sanitized UI snapshot, or restored current memory with current transient editor/history state preserved.
forwardMap: Use actual shared canvas snapshot/restore functions; deep-copy persistent/draft values, omit session buffers/history/callbacks/previews, preserve lens/inspection alias inside each snapshot and refuse malformed top-level snapshot records before mutation. Treat prototype-named draft entries as own properties.
partiality: Bounded JSON-compatible snapshots, valid state records and selected sanitation rules. Unknown-subject validation, complete window/viewport persistence, every storage adapter fault and a generic pure transition planner remain unproved.
failure: Malformed snapshot records refuse with invalid-workbench-snapshot; non-cloneable host values retain clone failures. Persisted malformed JSON no longer masquerades as successful empty restore.
authorityEffect: Bounded current runtime qualification only. Explicit host operations remain with the caller/server; no generic executable algebra, scientific acceptance or production execution grant follows.
stateOwner: Caller owns input program/capabilities; current client memory/controller own their local state. Returned snapshots have detached persistent values; explicit runtime evidence references remain shared where documented.
evidence: Hand-authored normative JSON cases plus semantic-translation-inspector-canvas.test.mjs in source, assembled SDK and both isolated bootstraps, with a pinned AST vocabulary catalogue.
default: Current public compatibility defaults remain explicit: omitted network uses authored net configuration, unknown lens mode selects options, absent transfer format uses REL, and omitted optional UI fields are sanitized. Retained no-default extraction intent is not asserted restored.

records.selection: Complete retained obligations selected; sparse reconstitution intent, if present, remains recorded as a separate variant.

forwardMap: Invoke the named current public operations and the actual shared browser call sites. Current command policy and explicitly invoked persistOptimisticDelta host orchestrator; not a restored pure effect planner.
partiality: A compatible injected appender must return a nonempty server revision. Legacy save success is distinct from a committed runtime receipt; receipt admission is owned by the server, not independently verified by the browser.
failure: Policy refusal, missing revision and host failures propagate; only stale save errors trigger refresh/replay, never failures after an accepted save.
authorityEffect: Bounded current runtime qualification only. Explicit host invocations remain with their caller/server; no generic algebra, execution grant or scientific authority follows.
evidence: Hand-authored normative cases and semantic-translation-browser-host.test.mjs executed in source, assembled SDK and both isolated bootstraps; these are bounded witnesses, not universal semantic equivalence.
default: Current public API compatibility defaults are retained where supplied by the implementation; retained no-default extraction intent is not claimed restored.

records.selection: Complete retained obligations selected; sparse reconstitution intent, if present, remains recorded as a separate variant.

default: Absent target lists remain fresh empty lists; null lists preserve the existing absence policy. sourceDomain: Current caller-owned runtime, valid FactStore lane destinations, canonical facts/deltas and publication metadata at the public browser delivery boundary.
targetDomain: Actual caller-memory lane, pending-queue and role-specific high-water transitions; this is not the retained pure planning API.
forwardMap: Preflight destinations and checked pending decode before queue/lane mutation, reject sequenced stale events, retain later pending local overlays, and use collision-free functional/type coordinate tuples for materialization.
reverseMapOrAbsence: Next current lane/runtime state does not reconstruct prior histories or acknowledged queue entries; no retained pure transition receipt is restored.
preservedInformation: Checked facts, functional slot/type identities, role aliases, later pending local facts, revisions and role-specific monotonic publication clocks.
lostInformation: Acknowledged queue entries, superseded functional values, input wire aliases and private planning/receipt identities.
identity: Serialized [prop,subject,predicate] or [isa,subject,type] tuple for materialization, plus separate frontend and backend safe sequence clocks.
partiality: Current named valid lane/store inputs and canonical payloads. Unknown named destinations refuse; no destination is a no-op. Unsequenced compatibility events do not establish monotonic delivery guarantees.
failure: Current typed lane/runtime and malformed-S refusals preserve the checked preimage. General transactional rollback for arbitrary host-mutator faults remains unproved.
authorityEffect: Mutates supplied caller lane/runtime state through existing engine operations; this is an explicit amendment of the retained effect-plan-only claim.
stateOwner: Caller memory owns durable/published/optimistic lanes and custody. Host/server authority is not synthesized by delivery qualification.
evidence: Counterexamples and normative cases plus sequence-order oracle, delimiter-bearing coordinate product, malformed payload and missing-lane preimage tests.
default: Current explicit compatibility defaults are recorded: absent/invalid sequence is zero, role alias preference is preserved and unknown event/no destination returns false.

records.selection: Complete retained obligations selected; sparse reconstitution intent, if present, remains recorded as a separate variant.

targetDomain: Actual mounted inspector with ordered backend/frontend reads, client memory, validated boot/query coordinates and one owned stream/controller disposer.
forwardMap: Use the current inspector orchestrator. Setup failure rolls back acquired resources; disposal attempts every listener removal, close, renderer disposal and container clear, then propagates the first cleanup fault, including a falsy thrown value. Hidden/persisted pages park publication callbacks; pageshow resumes.
partiality: Bounded startup/publication/lifecycle fixtures and the public session-ID boundary are qualified. Mutation/editor/manual-resolution/history action branches and arbitrary injected capability implementations remain unproved.
failure: Missing query refuses before snapshot reads. Setup failure retains original identity after cleanup attempts; cleanup fault does not prevent remaining cleanup; unreachable resources inside a throwing provider remain that provider responsibility.
authorityEffect: Bounded current runtime qualification only. Explicit host operations remain with the caller/server; no generic executable algebra, scientific acceptance or production execution grant follows.
stateOwner: Caller owns input program/capabilities; current client memory/controller own their local state. Returned snapshots have detached persistent values; explicit runtime evidence references remain shared where documented.

symmetryBreak: Transport Invocation Is Outside Contract Algebra

sourceDomain: Ordered canonical string-coordinate fact histories supplied as arrays, FactStore, wrappers or toArray adapters to the current public route declaration validators.
targetDomain: Ordered normalized declaration diagnostics or an explicit successful admission result; old route-command parameter compilation is unproved.
forwardMap: Fold retractions and reassertions into a fresh active snapshot, then run current route action, page renderer, startup resource and route-target declaration checks.
reverseMapOrAbsence: Diagnostics retain available fact source coordinates, but do not recover the complete history, private index or command execution receipt.
preservedInformation: Active declaration coordinates, selected provenance and current typed failure data for the checked cases.
lostInformation: Retracted entries, superseded identical assertions, input container identity and unselected declaration history.
identity: Unambiguous serialized subject/predicate/object tuple and per-call owned snapshot, rather than caller array identity.
partiality: Canonical string-coordinate fact inputs compatible with current route declaration APIs; generic route command/parameter algebra is not qualified.
failure: Current AdmissibilityError with normalized issues or returned declaration diagnostics; no missing command/permission execution proof is inferred.
authorityEffect: Read-only declaration observation; this gate grants no route execution permission.
stateOwner: Caller owns source histories; validator owns fresh active snapshot and local index.
evidence: Retraction/reassertion, mutable array reuse, source-form parity, target refusal, typed admission and independent bounded active-history oracle.
falsifier: Retracted keyword authorizes an action, removed route produces a diagnostic, or changed caller array reuses a stale index.
default: Empty declaration facts yield successful admission; this is not a grant to execute an absent route or command.

records.subject: module.runtimeDiagnostics

partiality: Issue records in formatting are null-free object-like values; invalid/null records and explicit redactor refusals propagate. Universal totality for arbitrary JavaScript values is not claimed.
failure: Redactor and invalid-input failures propagate; valid records format in stable order with explicit defaults.
stateOwner: The error owns a new issue array and normalized records; nested detail values may remain shared with the caller. Redactor ownership stays with the caller.
evidence: Empty/default formatting, exact location/context order, disclosure-first redactor precedence, explicit refusal and typed-error status/code witnesses.
